angle: DL/EDGE: Run-the-Hoop bend (Hoop G) and pass-rush-drill burst vs NFL pressure rate, NGS get-off and a new self-referenced in-game bend metric (NFL Arc G) from the game-tracking sample; year-standardized; baseline = log pick + weight + 10-yd split + EDGE share (6-covariate version with 3-cone + NGS athleticism as robustness, OLS/ridge/complete-case/mixed model)
metric_name: Hoop G: the hardest sideways push a rusher holds for 0.5 s while rounding the hoops (g, z within Combine year), shrunk by one-run reliability 0.41; NFL Arc G: the same quantity from snap to throw/sack on 20 random NFL pass rushes (reliability 0.70)
headline_number: Hoop G vs pressure after baseline: rho 0.34 [0.09, 0.56], n=63; out-of-class dR2 +0.075 [-0.249, 0.326]; best-of-7 permutation p=0.046 (10,000 shuffles); nested LOCO re-selects Hoop G 3/3 folds, dR2 +0.080, p=0.031; EB selection-shrunk effect 0.12 (~1.0 pressure per 450 rushes). New: Hoop G vs NFL Arc G raw 0.37 but 0.10 [-0.11, 0.32] (n=79) after weight + EDGE share; Arc G raises within-player pressure odds x1.90 [1.62, 2.23] per sd; Hoop G pressure effect unchanged with Arc G controlled (0.32).
what_changed_from_previous: Built on round_02/revised (which already applied the round-2 top_changes: small baseline + robustness table, best-of-7 and nested selection tests, EB shrinkage, refit-bootstrap dR2, Hoop reliability CI, 2025 full board with shrinkage arithmetic, pre-registered 2026-27 test, appendix stats table, 70-word plain opening). New this round: (1) NFL Arc G, a tracking-native in-game bend metric computed with the same formula as Hoop G on the game_frames_sample (self-referenced, no ball/opponents), with split-half reliability, a top-EPA replication, an EDGE-only cut, TOST and true-scale MDE; (2) Finding 3 tests the mechanism honestly: drill bend matches game arc only through size/alignment, game arc goes with pressure within a player (cluster-bootstrapped logit with play length), and Hoop G's pressure link does not run through game arc; (3) Fig 1 rebuilt as a true drill-vs-game bend card (hoop trace next to 20 rotated NFL rush paths, both coloured by sideways g, with pressure strip and neutral title); (4) new Fig 4 (arc chain); (5) board gains an 'NFL arc != drill' tape flag beside the rookie-pressure flag, with xlim widened so flags no longer overlap data; (6) best-of-7 permutation raised to 10,000 shuffles (p moved from 0.058 to 0.046, stated as on the line); (7) Fig 2 reliability strip includes Arc G, label overlaps fixed; (8) 1,948 words, 5 figures + 2 tables.
open_risks: Best-of-7 p=0.046 sits at the threshold and moved from 0.058 between Monte Carlo runs; only the nested test (p=0.031) clears comfortably, on 63 players.

Finding 3 weakens the football mechanism: Hoop G does not predict game arc beyond size/alignment (0.10), so judges may read the lead as a statistical artifact; true-scale MDE 0.59 means a moderate real link is not excluded.
Complete-case fit without imputed 10-yd splits drops to 0.22 [-0.09, 0.49] with no out-of-class gain.
Within-player arc-pressure odds ratio is partly reverse causation (rushers finish toward the QB after winning) and uses sampled-play pressure flags (time_to_pressure or sack).
Arc G rests on 20 random snaps per player with no blockers, so a forced wide arc looks like a chosen one; the 2025 board's arc flag covers only 27 of 42 runners.
